TRANSLATION STATUS 0.2

A much longer journey.

A native browser rewrite with the main campaign events through the Pokémon League. It is still not a complete, verified 1:1 recreation.

  • Smoother presentationAnimated tile movement, synchronized camera, paced dialogue, encounter transitions, move effects, rolling HP bars, capture and evolution animations.
  • Kanto campaign expansionEight gyms, Bill, S.S. Anne, Rocket Hideout, Pokémon Tower, Silph Co., Safari rewards, field moves, major puzzles, rivals, Elite Four and Hall of Fame.
  • Music and party systems46 original music scores played with Web Audio, TM/HM teaching, move-learning choices, level and stone evolution, PC deposit/withdraw, expanded items and shops.
  • Remaining differencesSome optional events and conditional dialogue, trades and link play, casino games, NPC walking, fishing and Safari rules, exact battle AI, capture odds, animation choreography, sound effects and hardware timing.

Targeted campaign and browser checks pass. A full uninterrupted campaign and frame-by-frame comparison against the original have not been completed. Old browser saves are supported.

FIELD GUIDE & OPTIONS

Take your time in Kanto.

Arrow keys or WASD move. Z or Enter talks and confirms; X goes back. On touch screens, use the A and B buttons. Escape opens the menu. During dialogue, one press reveals the current text; a fresh press advances once it has finished.

Music uses the original compositions, played through a browser synthesizer. Toggle it with the MUSIC button below the screen.

  1. Leave your house and head toward Route 1 to meet Oak.
  2. Choose your partner, battle your rival, and collect Oak’s parcel from Viridian Mart.
  3. Talk to Oak to deliver the parcel and receive your Pokédex.
  4. Train, catch Pokémon, and follow the journey notes through Kanto.

The Workbench lets you inspect maps and edit Pokémon data. Build notes list the remaining differences from the original game.
